Duplex 3+1+3 + verande te Kodra e Diellit 2 per shitje!
Ne Rezidencen Kodra e Diellit 2, ofrojme apartament ne forme duplex-i per shitje.
Apartamenti ndodhet katet 2 dhe 3 te nje objekti 7 katesh, ku hyrja e duplexit eshte ne katin 1. Me siperfaqe totale prej 241 m2, apartamenti organizohet:
- kati 1: siperfaqe 34.8 m2, 1 tualet dhe 1 depo
- kati 2: siperfaqe 84.15 m2, 1 sallon, 1 kuzhine gatimi dhe ngrenie, 1 dhome gjumi, verande 50 m2
- kati 3: siperfaqe 71.96 m2, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete
Apartamenti eshte i investuar totalisht, duke ofruar nje jetese komode. Orientimi nga lindja ofron pamje fantastike nga Dajti dhe ndricim natyral. Apartamenti shitet pjeserisht i mobiluar.
title_en: Duplex 3+1+3 + veranda in Kodra e Diellit 2 for sale!
description_en: Duplex 3+1+3 + veranda in Kodra e Diellit 2 for sale! In Residence Kodra e Diellit 2, we offer a duplex apartment for sale. The apartment is located on the 2nd and 3rd floors of a 7-story building, where the entrance to the duplex is on the 1st floor. With a total area of 241 m2, the apartment is organized: - 1st floor: 34.8 m2 area, 1 toilet and 1 storage room - 2nd floor: 84.15 m2 area, 1 living room, 1 cooking and dining kitchen, 1 bedroom, veranda 50 m2 - 3rd floor: surface 71.96 m2, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms The apartment is fully invested, offering a comfortable living. Orientation from the east offers fantastic views of Dajti and natural lighting. The apartment is sold partially furnished.
